ValidationRule.description: If order is complete and the below fields on the opportunity object are blank the rule will trigger
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(Order_Completed__c, "Yes") , OR( ( IM_Up_Sell_Quantity__c = NULL) ,
( IM_Up_Sell_Detail__c = NULL) ,
AND(( IM_Up_Sell_Sold_To__c= NULL),(Upsell_Customer_ID__c=NULL)) ,
( ISPICKVAL( IM_Unit_of_Measure__c , ""))), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Completed Orders, please fill out all Upsell fields
